description: Compares a 2026 or 2027 charitable gift (tax_year) made as a qualified charitable distribution from an IRA with the same gift in cash: the federal and state tax saved and the IRMAA surcharge saved, with the cash gift deducted the way the return allows (itemizing, or the standard deduction with the non-itemizer charitable deduction, whichever gives the lower tax). Computed by QuantCalc's federal and state tax APIs, as the website's QCD calculator; requires a connected QuantCalc PRO licence or Tax Season Pass, and without one returns no figures and names the free page. Not tax advice.

age.description: The IRA owner's age reached in the tax year (a QCD needs 70½ on the day of the gift).

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, married filing jointly (mfj), married filing separately (mfs) or head of household (hoh).

gift.description: The charitable gift planned for the tax year.

ira_balance.description: The IRA balance, which caps the QCD. Default: large enough, stated.

ira_withdrawal.description: The tax year's IRA withdrawal (RMD included) before the gift: with a cash gift all of it is income, with a QCD the QCD part is not. Default 0.

mortgage_interest.description: Mortgage interest paid in the tax year (Schedule A). Default 0.

pension.description: Taxable pension and annuity income. Default 0.

social_security.description: Gross Social Security benefits of the household. Default 0.

spouse_age.description: Joint return only: the spouse's age reached in the tax year. Default the same as age, stated.

spouse_split.description: Joint return only: whose the IRA withdrawal and pension are on the state return (even, filer or spouse). Default even, stated.

state.description: Optional: two-letter code of the state (or DC) for the state tax line. Absent: federal only.

state_local_income_tax.description: State and local income tax paid in the tax year (Schedule A), for the itemize-or-standard comparison. Default 0.

tax_year.description: The tax year: 2026 (default) or 2027. 2027: the federal tax on the IRS's published 2027 amounts (Rev. Proc. 2026-35) and the amounts the law fixes; the state line on each state's 2026 rules (most states have not published 2027's), labelled as such; the IRMAA effect on the 2026 tiers (the later tiers are not published); a QCD above the 2026 limit ($111,000) is refused for 2027, since the 2027 QCD limit is not published yet. Stated in the result.

name: qcd_tax_savings
title: Tax saved by a QCD instead of a cash gift
